apiMessages.content: Add overhead press to Wednesday's upper body workout, 5 sets of 5.

Keep overhead work off Wednesday's session. If you want, I can add non-overhead pulling/pressing volume (row, lat pulldown variants) to that workout instead — want me to do that?
